content.value:
A gearbox has six spindle speeds for a machine tool. If the size of the cutter to be used is 20   
from 5 to 20 111111 in diameter and cutting speed is 21 mm/min. Calculate the common ratio   
for G.P. series of speed and hence the various spindle speed.
